title: #077. Skill Coverage, Senior Leads & Incompatible Staff Pairs
subtitle: Combine shift skill requirements, mandatory senior lead presence, and forbidden incompatible pair rules in staff rostering.

judge.m0: Output must be an object { schedule, totalCost }.
judge.m2: schedule[{p0}][{p1}] must be an integer in [-1, {p3}] (received {p2}).
judge.m3: Day {p0}, shift {p1} has {p2} staff assigned, below demand {p3}.
judge.m4: Day {p0}, shift {p1} has no senior lead assigned.
judge.m5: Day {p0}, shift {p1} has only {p3} staff with skill {p2}, below requirement {p4}.
judge.m6: Incompatible pair ({p0}, {p1}) are both assigned to day {p2}, shift {p3}.
judge.m7: Reported totalCost ({p0}) does not match computed shift cost ({p1}).
judge.m8: Valid roster, but total cost ({p0}) exceeds minimum ({p1}).
